method.geometry: Actual decoded published Draco LOD1; production architectureMatrix using actual all-LOD bounds; double-sided visibility.
method.nearbyPrefilter: World transformed actual mesh bounding box intersects ray within20m before triangles.
method.riskThreshold: A hit more than2.4m from start is >2m behind collision boundary; report as setback.
limitations: Single outward horizontal ray per sample; missing at 1.2m signals collision readability risk, not proof the area is visually open at every height or angle.
Gate openings, deliberate vistas, roofs, low props and geometry further than8m can count as missing although a different view may communicate boundary.
Collision and floor polygons are unchanged; this audit does not prove reachable out-of-bounds or navigation defects.
Short raster step edges receive one midpoint each, so global percentage weights diagonals more densely than long straight runs.

lengthWeighted.notes: Each sample represents its segment length divided by sample count; midpoint quadrature, not continuous mesh coverage.
